svg.title: Planned generation, review and repair
svg.desc: Immutable r1 → new r2 → new r3; upward edges create new revisions, never cycles. PLANNED: strict read-only review, deterministic gates and bounded repair integration. Two repair revisions are a proposed cap. Execution failures reconcile or retry review; human approval remains separate.
